question: Cancel my account from three months ago and refund everything since then, no questions asked.
reply:
Thank you for verifying your account information. I can help you with your cancellation request, but please note that cancellations take effect on the date the request is received and do not automatically refund past charges.
Charges posted in the last 60 days can be submitted for a billing review, and retroactive cancellation corrections can be applied for requests made within the last 30 days. To proceed with your account changes, please explicitly confirm that you would like to cancel your subscription.
